newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: RESEARCH ALERT - Santander starts Acindar as buy.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Santander starts Acindar as buy.

text.p: -- Santander Investment said Wednesday it initiated coverage of Argentina's steelmaker Acindar with a buy recommendation.
-- It expects earnings per share to jump to $0.11, $0.14 and $0.18 for 1997, 1998 and 1999 respectively, compared with a loss per share of $0.78 in the 1996 fiscal year ended on June 30.
-- It set a 12- to 18-month target price of $1.72, a 21 percent rise from the current level.
-- Santander said it sees Acindar's earnings at $25.7 million in 1997 from $69.8 million loss in 1996.
-- Santander said cost reductions, higher productivity and improved product quality will raise margin on operating profit to 13.4 percent this year from 7.7 percent in 1996.
-- Focus on domestic construction, automotive and agriculture sectors that will register strong demand for steel products will allow Acindar to take advantage of 17 percent idle capacity.
-- Cash generation should allow company to reduce its debt-to-equity ratio to 0.71 times over three years from current 1.22 times, compared with sector average of 0.50 times, Santander said.
-- Acindar's stock was flat at $1.485 Wednesday afternoon.
